## Joseki

<A:N14> is the right continuation for White in AI’s view.

<B:S12> is very aggressive and hard to refute, though AI doesn’t appreciate it.

See [Jiang Weijie, commenting a Samsung Cup game: Shin Jinseo v. Xie Erhao](https://gochn2en.net/wp/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Sumsang_cup_Shin_Xie.pdf).
